firstPlayerRule: Roll dice to determine the starting player. Give that player the white die and place their marker on top of the initial turn-order stack.
houseFallback: Agree before rolling that the highest roll starts, and reroll any tie for highest.
clarifications: At the start of a round, all players roll their dice. The starting player places the goods tile using the white die and takes the first turn; other turns follow the turn-order track.
